gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: read(CharBuffer) on a sequence backed by a single non-empty reader should copy one character into a writable target buffer and report one char read.
ADDED i3: The first character of the source string is copied into the buffer's backing array.
ADDED i4: read(CharBuffer) into a buffer with no remaining capacity (after flip on an empty buffer) should return 0 without reading anything.
ADDED i5: read() on a sequence whose only reader is empty should report end-of-stream.
ADDED i6: read(CharBuffer) should propagate ReadOnlyBufferException when given a read-only buffer (one wrapping a CharSequence).
ADDED i7: Buffers wrapping a CharSequence are read-only.
ADDED i10: close() should succeed on a sequence built from a reader array that contains null entries alongside a real reader.
ADDED i11: skip(long) on an empty sequence should skip nothing and return 0.
